item.title: Finding the total number of processors on a machine with .NET
item.description: In this post I show how to find the total number of logical CPUs on a host (not just those available to a process); something that isn't exposed in modern .NET Link to article: https://andrewlock.net/finding-the-total-number-of-processors-on-a-machine-with-dotnet/
